title: Certify a two-register P104 endpoint ADD retiming
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This finite construction retimes the late X90/N90 ADD in the exact P104 physical dual from #2662. Moving both operands into the full chart replaces H6+H7+2H1 by H7+H8: 1,942 transports become 1,940, with unchanged rank mass 3,542, scalar order and coefficients, all 358 public inputs/outputs, 150 dirty-helper restorations and eight exact private erasures. The local child sum strictly decreases for 0<p<1.

The scoped package supplies the physical operator proof, complete literal word, two native recipes, exact pins and independently authored dense/native checker. It does not claim a new supplier, kappa, practical runtime gain or optimum. Full native cold replay of unchanged edges, owners/hosting, scalar/address and idle/residual costs, precision/rounded cleanup, the other 102 Gram/2 rows and all-size admission remain unresolved.

## Task and overlap

Task `p104-side-correction`, priority revision 5, scope refined to one X90/N90 endpoint window (source events 3897-5152), following the donor's choice and the two-register-compensation handoff in [Discussion 2619](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2619). Scientific baseline: `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850`. Exact sources: #2662 `b67542b2896c21106f3945673bbf5b6e131408cc` and #2586 `7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1`.

Concurrent #2712 (`afa5d6649460dcdb93489babd74f0ee9d01a4911`) uses the same standard common-chart identity on different early Y0/Y1 stars with ZERO-source transports. This package adds the later X90/N90 occurrence, rank-seven/eight transports from nonzero frames and separate complete verification. No first-mechanism or combined-word claim is made. Its proof and source rewrite were inspected. Latest-updated 100 open PR bodies and the relevant discussion were checked; this is partial overlap coverage, not a novelty guarantee.

Final main refresh at 2026-10-15 18:25 UTC: `78ceed4139bc61be797f6d38f21a03d972bb3290`. Guidance, task catalogue, selected record, package runner and live native inputs are unchanged. The final comparison adds only the 16 files in this package. This final submission checkpoint supplements the earlier checkpoint retained in TASK.json.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.14 on Windows 11, standard library only:

```text
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-dual-add-retiming
```

All four registered commands passed, including optimized primary/independent checks, native regeneration and Git-free export/integrity controls. Primary checks cover all 128,164 endpoint coefficients and 1,024 native columns. The independent checker performs 2,048 exact Gaussian direct/composed-column equalities and 11 controls. Controls reject unpaid compensation, incompatible charts, wrong phase/coefficient, dependency changes, cleanup failures and source/receipt corruption.

Two separate agents reconstructed the result independently; a third reviewed the final proof/code/source bindings and found no actionable defect. The published head `71d24b655c2fdddc063b9aaf285e8425ce197499` was fetched back: all 16 files match the tested Git-byte export exactly. No hosted CI, independent human review or formal-kernel check is claimed.

## Credit

Credit commdata2338/#2662 for endpoint fusion and the ADD-barrier handoff; ywz65/#2586 for the physical dual and #2712 for concurrent shared-chart work. Full inherited lineage and unchanged source notices are retained in README and predecessor snapshots. Common-chart linearity and strict subadditivity are standard. Prepared for Vasek (flyingviper) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof, implementation, checks and writing; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

The README names the smallest useful follow-up: construct actual X90/N90 owner windows and count all idle/residual charges to determine whether hosting repays the local saving. No compatible owner schedule or precision/tape contract is supplied. Composing further retimings would require dependency compatibility, a regenerated complete word and the family expansion gate; this contribution stops at the single finite result.
